# Edina Boys Golf

Official website of Edina High School Boys Golf — one of the most decorated high school golf programs in Minnesota history with 10 state championships.

## About This Site

This site provides schedules, scores, rosters, stats, and season recaps for the Edina Hornets boys golf program. Data is updated throughout the season.

## Team

- School: Edina High School, Edina, Minnesota
- Conference: Lake Conference
- Sport: Golf (Boys)
- Season: Spring

## Featured Athletes

Chase Larson — Class of 2027 varsity golfer. Junior competing on the AJGA and JGS junior golf circuits. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/chaselarsongolf/

## Pages

- /roster — Full varsity and JV roster with scoring averages and player profiles
- /schedule — Season schedule with results
- /scores — Leaderboards and individual scores by event
- /stats — Season statistics and individual performance
- /history — Program history and state championship records
- /photos — Season photo galleries

## Contact

For program inquiries, visit edinaboysgolf.com
